name: Zelle®
former_names: SurePay (Wells Fargo's pre-2017 P2P brand on clearXchange; still present in site meta keywords); clearXchange (network predecessor co-founded by Wells Fargo, 2011)
network: Early Warning Services (Zelle network); Wells Fargo is an EWS owner bank
ui_position: Mobile: 'Zelle®' in bottom navigation bar. Desktop web (observed, logged in): 'Transfer & Pay' opens a panel headed 'Move Money & Pay Bills' listing Transfer Money · Pay WF Accounts · Pay Bills · Send Money with Zelle® · Wire Money · Send with ExpressSend® · Deposit a Check (Zelle is fourth). Zelle left menu: Send | Request | Scheduled | Activity | Family controls | Recipients | Manage payment profiles | Blocked contacts | Help. Fargo: purple Fargo icon in search bar.
description: Bank-embedded P2P send/request/split via email, U.S. mobile number or (business-only) Zelle tag; QR code pay; recurring and future-dated; Fargo assistant can send to stored contacts. No standalone app since April 2025.

sub_products.name: Send money with Zelle®
sub_products.description: Send to an enrolled recipient by email/U.S. mobile/Zelle tag, from phone contacts, or by scanning a Zelle QR code; one-time, future-dated or repeating.
sub_products.other_flags: repeat_payment_toggle: Yes; schedule_up_to_1_year: Yes; unenrolled_recipient_14_day_window: Yes; fargo_voice_send_to_stored_contacts: Yes; block_contact: Yes; red_cross_donation_shortcut: Yes; limits_consumer: $3,500/24h, $20,000/30d (risk-based higher); limits_business: $15,000/24h, $60,000/30d; web_inline_limit_display: Yes; web_static_scam_banner_every_visit: Yes
sub_products.notes: Send flow verbatim (FAQ): Zelle® in bottom nav (web: Transfer and Pay > Send Money with Zelle®) → Send/Request → add or select recipient → amount + funding account → Continue → 'Carefully review the details of your payment before you send it. If it's the first time you've sent money to this recipient, we will send you an access code... If your recipient's U.S. mobile number or email address is enrolled with Zelle®, we'll display the name of the recipient on record before you continue (in some cases, this may only be a first name).' → confirmation screen. Notifications: email + secure inbox on schedule/change; email on fail/cancel; texts from 93557 or 93729 on new recipient / first-time send. Blocks are tied to the contact's enrollment at their bank (re-enrolling elsewhere clears a block). Refreshed marketing page frames use cases as split costs, recurring rent/utilities, QR 'Scan. Pay. Done.' for local merchants. No scam interstitial or payment-purpose prompt documented; scam victims call 1-800-956-4442; 'Qualifying imposters scams may be eligible for reimbursement.'

capability_detail.step-up-auth: Access code (text to registered mobile or RSA SecurID) for first-time recipient and selected payments; Advanced Access

sub_products.name: Request money with Zelle®
sub_products.description: Request a payment from an enrolled Zelle user by choosing your own enrolled email/mobile instead of a funding account on the 'Send or Request' screen.
sub_products.other_flags: max_pending_requests_consumer: 35; request_only_to_enrolled_users: Yes; debt_collection_prohibited: Yes; split_marketed_as_use_case_only: Yes; respond_to_token_selector: Yes
sub_products.notes: Requests limited to enrolled users; recipient may decline/ignore; up to 35 pending requests (non-small-business).

sub_products.name: Receive money with Zelle® (incl. Zelle tag & QR for business)
sub_products.description: Receive to the deposit account linked to enrolled email/mobile/tag; small business can share a Zelle tag and 'Show your QR code' to get paid.
sub_products.other_flags: zelle_tag_business_only: Yes; no_receive_limit: Yes; commercial_accounts_cannot_receive: Yes
sub_products.notes: Zelle tags restricted to small business customers (FAQ + Addendum §3).

sub_products.name: Family controls (parent-managed Zelle® access for teen account holders)
sub_products.description: Zelle menu item 'Family controls' = 'Update Zelle® access for teens': lists any teen account holder(s) with an Enabled/Disabled state and 'Zelle® access enabled by <parent> on <date>'; the parent toggles Enable/Disable. Not described on any public Wells Fargo page captured in the study and not present in any peer inventory built from public sources.
sub_products.other_flags: teen_access_toggle: Yes
sub_products.notes: Observed in a logged-in web session (web screen only); mobile presence not observed.

sub_products.name: Zelle® contact and profile controls (Blocked contacts; Manage payment profiles)
sub_products.description: Web screens for two capabilities the public record already documents: 'Blocked contacts' lists blocked senders/requesters ('To block someone, go to Zelle® Activity and open a past payment or request'; blocking is documented publicly, S005), and 'Manage payment profiles' ('Receive money with Zelle®') shows each enrolled token (mobile, email) mapped to a deposit account with 'Edit account' and 'Unenroll' per token (receive mapping documented publicly under WF-P01-S03) plus a link to update contact information.
sub_products.other_flags: block_contact_from_activity: Yes; per_token_account_mapping: Yes
sub_products.notes: Observed on web; mobile not observed. Not a new capability — the screens give the public capabilities a management surface.

name: Transfers (Transfer Money)
network: Wells Fargo (ACH via Nacha for external)
ui_position: Mobile: 'Transfer' in bottom bar; 'Scheduled Transfers & Payments'. Web: 'Transfer and Pay' > 'Transfer Money' screen ('Add Non-Wells Fargo Accounts' button); 'Transfer and payment Activity' with View/Edit, View/Delete. Fargo: 'Make a payment or transfer'.
description: Move money between Wells Fargo accounts (immediate), to/from accounts at other U.S. financial institutions ('Bank-to-bank transfers' / 'Add Non-Wells Fargo Accounts'), pay Wells Fargo credit/loan accounts, automatic savings transfers, brokerage transfers.

sub_products.name: Between your accounts (internal transfer)
sub_products.description: Same-day immediate transfer between Wells Fargo deposit/credit accounts; future-dated and recurring with Frequency and Memo.
sub_products.other_flags: memo_field: Yes; edit_delete_until_1159pm_PT_day_before: Yes; atm_transfers: Yes

sub_products.name: Bank-to-bank transfers (external, 'Transfer between banks')
sub_products.description: Link an external (non-Wells Fargo) account by routing and account number with an ownership attestation, then transfer to/from it. Observed (web): two account-use tiers — 'Payments only' (pay WF credit accounts from it) vs 'Transfers and payments' (outbound/inbound transfers); upgrading requires 'additional security measures (may take 2-3 business days)'; 'Set up for transfers' on an already-verified payments-only account completed instantly with no review step. No aggregator/credential-login option on the add-account form; 'To transfer money to another person, use Zelle®.'
sub_products.other_flags: outbound_2_biz_days: Yes; inbound_3_biz_days: Yes; expedited_next_day_discretionary: Yes; inbound_holds_3_4_biz_days: Yes; pay_WF_credit_accounts_while_pending_verification: Yes; account_use_tiers_payments_only_vs_transfers: Yes; frequency_options_web: Once, Daily, Weekly, Every two weeks, Twice a month, Last Friday of month, Monthly
sub_products.notes: Transfers FAQ (browser): 'click Add Non-Wells Fargo Accounts to get started... additional security measures are required. Verification may take 1-3 business days'; no instant/aggregator verification offered. Initial delivery speed 2 business days outbound / 3 inbound; 'Depending on your history of transfer activity, expedited transfer options may be available.' Mobile edit/delete: 'select Transfer in the bottom bar, tap on each transfer listed under Scheduled Transfers & Payments, and select Edit Transfer or Delete Transfer'; cutoff 11:59 pm PT the day before. Same-day transfers to Wells Fargo accounts cannot be canceled once submitted.

capability_detail.step-up-auth: Advanced Access code when receiving from a new non-WF account; additional security measures at add-account

sub_products.name: Wells Fargo payments (pay WF credit card/loan from WF or external account)
sub_products.description: Pay a Wells Fargo credit card or loan from a WF deposit account or a linked external account. Observed (web): 'Pay My Wells Fargo Accounts' is the same single form as Transfer Money (From / To / Frequency / Amount → Continue), with 'Credit card Autopay terms' and a 'Transfer & payment activity' rail listing scheduled items (View / Edit → 'Autopay Details' with the fields From / To / Frequency / Next payment / Ending / Amount option / Status and the actions Delete Autopay / Edit Autopay / One-time payment).
sub_products.other_flags: external_funding_3_4_biz_days: Yes; cutoff_midnight_PT: Yes

sub_products.name: Saving made easy (automatic recurring savings transfer)
sub_products.description: Automatic recurring transfers into a WF savings account.

sub_products.name: Brokerage transfers (WellsTrade / Wells Fargo Advisors)
sub_products.description: Transfers to/from linked brokerage accounts, 1–3 business days; phone 1-800-TRADERS.

sub_products.name: Stop future payments (online ACH debit stop) and Stop a check
sub_products.description: Accounts menu 'Stop Future Payments': select account → Continue → stop a merchant's future ACH debits online. In-page help scopes the online stop to ACH payments: a single check is stopped on the 'Stop a Check' page; a range of checks, a recurring debit-card payment, or a credit-card transaction require a phone call (1-800-869-3557 / number on the card); Bill Pay payments are cancelled on the Bill Pay page.
sub_products.other_flags: online_scope: ACH debits and single checks only; recurring card stops by phone
sub_products.notes: Adjacent capability (stop payments), not a transfer rail; observed on web.

name: Bill Pay (Online Bill Pay / Business Bill Pay)
network: Wells Fargo (processor not disclosed); RTP network (The Clearing House) for instant payments
ui_position: Web: 'Transfer and Pay' > Bill Pay ('Add Payee', 'Manage Payee', 'Payment History'). Mobile: Bill Pay in Transfer & Pay. Fargo: 'Which bills are due?'
description: Pay nearly any U.S. company or individual; electronic or mailed paper check; eBills; auto pay; Payment Guarantee; Bill Pay 'instant payments' over the RTP network in response to a payee's Request for Payment (mobile only).

sub_products.name: Add payee & pay a bill (one-time / scheduled)
sub_products.description: Add payee manually, browse list or search; schedule up to 1 year ahead; electronic or paper check delivery; 'Send On' date and 'Deliver by' date.
sub_products.other_flags: paper_check_fallback: Yes; payment_guarantee: Yes; no_tax_or_court_payments: Yes; per_payment_limit_checking: $50,000

sub_products.name: Auto pay (automatic recurring payments)
sub_products.description: Set timing and amount rules; service pays recurring bills automatically, including variable-amount eBills.
sub_products.notes: Marketed lowercase 'auto pay'; OAA calls it 'automatic (recurring)' payments.

sub_products.name: eBills
sub_products.description: Electronic versions of bills viewable/payable/printable in Bill Pay; reminders; activation from Bill Pay home, 'Manage Payee', or new payee setup; WF loan eBills.
sub_products.other_flags: biller_approval_up_to_10_biz_days: Yes

sub_products.name: Bill Pay instant payments (RTP, in response to Request for Payment)
sub_products.description: For participating payees only, in the Wells Fargo Mobile app: pay a payee's Request for Payment instantly; the service 'may use the RTP® network ... or another third party network'; funds typically available within seconds 24/7; cannot be canceled or amended; $50,000 per payment; not excluded from the Bill Pay Payment Guarantee (explicit RfP carve-out).
sub_products.other_flags: request_for_payment_inbound: Yes; mobile_only: Yes; limit_per_payment: $50,000; cannot_exceed_requested_amount: Yes
sub_products.notes: Only documented in Online Access Agreement §6(i) and Payment Guarantee exclusions; no marketing page found. Confirms WF consumer RTP send (credit-push) capability.

name: Digital Wires (Wire Money)
ui_position: Web/mobile: 'Transfer & Pay' > 'Wire Money'; sub-pages 'Recipients', 'Recipient's bank info', wire 'Activity', 'Wire details'. Enrollment deep link serviceType=digitalwires.
description: Send domestic and international wires in USD or 30 foreign currencies to 200+ countries from Wells Fargo Online, Business Online or mobile; branch wires for amounts above digital limits.

sub_products.name: Domestic wire (USD)
sub_products.description: Same-business-day if by 3:00 pm PT; recipient saved for reuse; statuses Scheduled/Pending/Completed/Failed/Canceled/Returned/Under review.
sub_products.other_flags: daily_and_rolling_30d_limits: Yes; above_limit_branch_only: Yes; internal_security_review: Yes; compare_options_explainer_in_flow: Yes; add_recipient_wizard_3_steps_with_aba_lookup: Yes
sub_products.notes: Recurring and future-dated wires (Preauthorized Orders) per OAA §8(h).

capability_detail.step-up-auth: Required: valid U.S. mobile number (text code) or RSA SecurID device

sub_products.name: International wire (USD or foreign currency)
sub_products.description: SWIFT/BIC + IBAN/country codes (BSB, CLABE, IFSC, Sort Code, etc.); foreign-currency option locks rate; consumer FX wires $0 fee; 30-minute cancellation right for consumer international wires (Reg E remittance).
sub_products.other_flags: foreign_currency_rate_lock: Yes; 30_min_cancel_consumer: Yes; purpose_of_payment_some_countries: Yes; cutoff_2_20pm_PT: Yes; fx_estimate_tool_before_wire: Yes

capability_detail.step-up-auth: U.S. mobile text code or RSA SecurID

sub_products.name: Receive incoming wire
sub_products.description: Domestic ABA 121000248; SWIFT WFBIUS6S; incoming FX converted to USD without notice; no incoming fee for consumer/non-analyzed business, $15 analyzed.

name: ExpressSend®
network: Wells Fargo proprietary remittance network with named Remittance Network Members: Mexico – BBVA, Banorte, Banco Santander (account only), Soriana*, Telecomm Telégrafos (Financiera para el Bienestar)*, Farmacias Guadalajara*, Bodega Aurrera*, Walmart*, Superama*; Dominican Republic – Banco BHD León*, Banreservas*; El Salvador – Banco Agrícola, Banco Davivienda Salvadoreño, Sistema Fedecrédito, Banco Cuscatlán, Remesas BAC Credomatic, Despensa Don Juan*, Despensa Familiar*, Walmart*, Maxi Despensa*; Guatemala – Banrural, Banco Industrial, G&T Continental; Honduras – Banco Ficohsa, Banco Atlántida; Nicaragua – Banpro, Banco LAFISE BANCENTRO; Colombia – BBVA, Bancolombia, Banco Davivienda, Grupo Éxito*; Ecuador – Banco Guayaquil, SERVIPAGOS (via Produbanco)*, Banco Bolivariano; Peru – BBVA, Banco de Crédito del Perú, Interbank (account only); India – ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Axis Bank (account only); Philippines – BPI, BDO Unibank, Metrobank (account only), PNB, M. Lhuillier*, Cebuana Lhuillier*; Vietnam – Vietinbank, Vietcombank. (* cash pick-up only)
ui_position: Mobile: 'Pay & Transfer' (a.k.a. Transfer & Pay) > 'Transfer Internationally' (ExpressSend) > 'Who are you sending to?' / 'How much are you sending?' / 'Activity'. Enrollment deep link serviceType=ExpressSendNative.
description: Consumer person-to-person remittance to 12 countries (Mexico, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, India, Philippines, Vietnam) with account credit or cash pickup through named Remittance Network Members. Two tracks coexist: (1) legacy ExpressSend service agreements — first remittance in person at a branch (or by Phone Bank for existing customers), later remittances at a branch, by Phone Bank, or through Wells Fargo Online on a desktop/laptop ('Transfer and Pay' > 'Send to Another Country'); (2) ExpressSend Mobile — nationwide launch announced Sep 14 2026 (in app release notes from v26.06.00, Jun 29 2026), first mobile transfer fee waived, up to 10 recipients, real-time tracking and alerts; once a customer accepts the mobile terms the service becomes app-only ('You'll no longer be able to use it in a web browser, at a branch, or by phone'). No recurring or future-dated transfers on either track. Wells Fargo states it is 'the only major U.S. bank offering a dedicated mobile remittance service'.

sub_products.name: Send to bank account abroad
sub_products.description: Credit to recipient's qualifying account (CLABE for Mexico, IFSC for India); paid in local currency for MX/DO/GT/HN/CO/IN/PH and USD for EC/SV/NI/PE/VN.
sub_products.other_flags: max_recipients_mobile: 10; first_mobile_transfer_fee_waived: Yes; real_time_tracking_and_alerts: Yes; legacy_web_desktop_only: Yes; legacy_first_remittance_branch_or_phone: Yes
sub_products.notes: Account-credit Remittance Network Members by country captured (see product network_or_vendor); beneficiary account must be denominated in the receiving currency (local currency for Mexico, DR, Guatemala, Honduras, Colombia, India, Philippines; USD for Ecuador, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Peru, Vietnam). Estimator data shows per-member daily/30-day limits (e.g., Colombia $1,500/day; Ecuador $1,000/day; minimum $25). Up to 10 recipients in mobile. Legacy web cancel path: 'Transfer and Pay' > 'Send to Another Country' > 'History' > select remittance.

sub_products.name: Send for cash pickup
sub_products.description: Recipient collects cash at supported location with government ID matching name exactly (fingerprint/photo may be required); 15 days to collect, else auto-cancel and refund.
sub_products.other_flags: uncollected_15_days_auto_cancel: Yes; cash_pickup_support_1_800_556_0605: Yes
sub_products.notes: Cash-pickup Remittance Network Members by country captured (retail chains such as Soriana, Walmart, Bodega Aurrera, Farmacias Guadalajara, Grupo Éxito, M. Lhuillier, Cebuana Lhuillier are cash-pickup only). Recipient name must exactly match government ID; 'Any cash pick-up transfer not picked up by the recipient within 15 days will be canceled without notice' and refunded to the funding account (check mailed if account closed). Cash pickup issues: 1-800-556-0605.

name: Mobile Deposit (Wells Fargo Mobile® Deposit)
ui_position: Mobile: 'Deposit' in bottom bar, or long-press app icon > 'Deposit Checks'; screens 'Deposit to'/'To', 'Enter Amount', photo capture, 'Deposit' button.
description: Camera check deposit in the Wells Fargo Mobile app with guided capture, on-screen limits, email + Message Center confirmation, 9 pm PT cutoff.

sub_products.name: Deposit a check by photo
sub_products.description: Endorse with 'For Mobile Deposit at Wells Fargo Only' (or check the mobile-deposit box), capture front/back, confirm, submit; first $400 generally same-day.
sub_products.other_flags: default_account_setting: Yes; daily_and_30d_limits_on_screen: Yes; hold_notifications: Yes; retain_check_5_days: Yes

name: ATM & branch deposits/transfers
ui_position: ATM menu (transfers, credit card payment, deposits); Contactless Symbol for wallet/contactless card access.
description: Envelope-free ATM cash/check deposits (ATM scans checks, counts bills), ATM transfers between accounts and WF credit card payments, digital-wallet/contactless card-free ATM access, e-receipts; branch wires ($40) and deposits; Bank by Mail.

sub_products.name: ATM deposit (cash/check) and ATM transfer/payment
sub_products.description: Scan checks and count bills at ATM; transfer between personal or business accounts; pay WF credit card; 9 pm local cutoff; receipts by text/email/secure inbox.
sub_products.other_flags: card_free_wallet_access: Yes; contactless_card_tap: Yes; talking_atm: Yes

sub_products.name: Branch wire / branch deposit
sub_products.description: Branch-initiated wires for amounts above digital limits or when digital wire cannot be completed; $40 branch wire fee.

sub_products.name: Cashier's checks (online order) and money orders (branch)
sub_products.description: Cashier's check ordered online ('Order a cashier's check': payable to ≤87 characters, amount, account to charge, terms checkbox → Submit; request 'reviewed and approved', then shipped by express delivery with signature required; U.S. addresses only, no PO Boxes; $2,000 per check and $6,000 per month per customer — observed) or at a branch; money orders at branch only.
sub_products.other_flags: online_order_limit: $2,000; monthly_limit: $6,000; stop_reissue_branch_only: Yes
sub_products.notes: Online-services fee schedule (verification pass).

sub_products.name: Foreign currency cash order (online; branch pickup required over $3,000)
sub_products.description: Accounts menu 'Foreign Currency' → 'Order Foreign Currency Cash': Check Rates; choose currency and amount (in USD or the foreign currency) → Calculate → order basket of up to 5 currencies. Minimum order $200; orders over $3,000 USD must be picked up at a branch; branches no longer sell foreign currency cash over the counter for same-day purchase; business accounts must order in a branch.
sub_products.other_flags: min_order_usd: 200; branch_pickup_over_usd: 3000

name: Direct Pay for Business
ui_position: Business Online: 'Transfer & Pay' (page also says 'Transfers & Payments') > 'Direct Pay for Business'; tabs 'Payees', 'Payments' > 'Create Payment'; pay groups 'Individual Master List' / 'Business Master List'; 'Enroll Another TIN' under General.
description: Business Online ACH credit origination to employees, contractors, sales agents and vendors (U.S., Guam, PR, USVI); payee validation; one-time or recurring; next-business-day delivery; four user access levels giving input/approve/release separation; $10/month plus per-payment fees.

sub_products.name: Pay employees/contractors (direct deposit)
sub_products.description: Individual Master List payees; net pay, bonuses, reimbursements; optional notification emails to payee.
sub_products.other_flags: schedule_13_months_ahead: Yes; cutoff_3pm_PT: Yes; next_biz_day: Yes; limit_tiers: Higher: $50k/individual payment, $500k/day; Lower: $5k/payment, $25k/day
sub_products.notes: Direct Pay FAQ (browser): enroll via Business Online 'Transfer and Pay' > 'Direct Pay for Business'; 'Enroll Another TIN' on the Direct Pay Main Page; $10/month per enrolled business, $0 to Wells Fargo personal accounts, $0.50 to non-WF personal accounts, $3 to business accounts; cutoff 3:00 pm PT; funds debited 3:00 pm PT on Send On Date; payee validation 2 business days (WF accounts) / up to 3 (other banks); edits to payee routing/account re-trigger validation; schedule up to 13 months ahead; access levels Input/Release/Control, Input/Release, Input Only, No Access. FAQ remains silent on cancel/edit of scheduled payments, returns and Same Day ACH.

capability_detail.step-up-auth: RSA SecurID or Advanced Access 6-digit code at enrollment/sensitive actions

sub_products.name: Pay vendors / other businesses
sub_products.description: Business Master List payees; optional remittance information; $3 per payment to business accounts.
sub_products.other_flags: remittance_info: Yes; limit_business_payment: $250k (Higher tier)

name: Fargo® virtual assistant
network: Wells Fargo (Google Cloud Dialogflow/Gemini per press — not fetched; UNKNOWN here)
ui_position: Mobile: purple Fargo icon in the search bar; type or tap microphone.
description: AI-powered virtual assistant in the Wells Fargo Mobile app (smartphone only, consumer accounts only, English/Spanish). Published capabilities: 'Transferring between accounts and sending money with Zelle®', 'Updating account and card settings', bills-due view, 'Make a payment or transfer', 'View Zelle® transactions', 'Find my routing number', 'I need to turn my card off', balance/activity forecasts, spending and subscription insights. Zelle initiation is peer parity (BofA Erica offers the same); scale is the differentiator (>1B interactions, >3M Spanish-speaking users).

sub_products.name: Fargo-initiated Zelle send / transfer / bill view
sub_products.description: Conversational initiation of a Zelle payment to a stored contact or an account transfer; confirms in the standard flow.
sub_products.other_flags: spanish: Yes; subscription_tracking: Yes
sub_products.notes: Fargo page video transcripts cover balance forecast, spending summary and bills ('Here's what I found. Which would you like to pay?'); no transcript or FAQ describes the confirmation screen for a Fargo-initiated Zelle send. Mar 2026 press release confirms Fargo is used for 'sending money with Zelle®, paying bills, locating routing numbers'. Confirmation UX remains INFERRED (standard Zelle review + first-time-recipient access code).

name: Card Settings (card on/off, view recurring payments, digital wallets, account access) — formerly Control Tower℠
ui_position: Mobile: Menu > Card Settings — 'Easily activate or turn cards on or off, add cards to digital wallets, view recurring payments, and manage account access with Card Settings' (App Store description). Fargo prompt 'I need to turn my card off.' Business mobile: 'Card Controls'. The 'Control Tower' label no longer appears on any public page (all landing/FAQ URLs 404; site search empty).
description: MANAGE-stage capability: consolidated view of where a debit/credit card is stored — recurring payments & subscriptions, digital wallets, data aggregators — with card on/off and data-sharing controls. Launched nationwide Oct 2018. Note: turning a card off does not stop recurring transactions.

sub_products.name: View recurring payments & subscriptions on card; card on/off
sub_products.description: Card Controls (web 'Turn Card On or Off'; app 'Card Settings', formerly Control Tower): per card — Card details · Card On or Off · International usage on/off · Digital wallets panel (wallets the card is provisioned to) · Recurring payments & subscriptions panel (merchants on file). Disclosure: turning a card off is not a replacement for reporting it lost or stolen. (Observed on web.)
sub_products.other_flags: card_off_does_not_stop_recurring: Yes; data_sharing_controls: Yes

name: Digital wallet intersections (Paze, PayPal, Apple/Google/Samsung Pay, card-free ATM)
ui_position: Mobile: Menu > Card Settings > Digital Wallet.
description: Wells Fargo is a Paze participating bank (EWS wallet; some cards pre-added; enroll via Menu > Card Settings > Digital Wallet > Paze); cards can be added to PayPal (up to 24; small-business credit cards must be added in PayPal), Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay and Garmin Pay; wallets enable card-free access at WF and participating non-WF ATMs. No Apple Cash/Venmo funding guidance published.

sub_products.name: Paze enrollment/activation
sub_products.description: Consumer debit/credit cards (not business) available in Paze; one-time activation in app or at checkout via email/OTP.
sub_products.other_flags: business_cards_excluded: Yes

sub_products.name: Add WF card to PayPal / wallets from WF app
sub_products.description: Add a Wells Fargo card to digital wallets. Observed (web 'Add Cards to Digital Wallets'): 'Available wallets' offers PayPal push-provisioning directly from the web; Apple Pay / Google Pay are added from the phone via an on-page QR code ('Scan to add cards to digital wallets'); Paze® mark present. Mobile app: Card Settings > Digital Wallet.

name: Early Pay Day & inbound instant receive (RTP/FedNow/Zelle credits)
description: Early Pay Day posts eligible ACH direct deposits up to two business days early (no enrollment, no fee). The product page explicitly lists RTP® and FedNow® credits as ineligible — confirming WF receives both instant rails into consumer accounts.

sub_products.name: Receive RTP / FedNow instant credit
sub_products.description: Inbound instant payments post to WF accounts (evidenced only by Early Pay Day exclusion list and TCH participant list); customer-facing status/labels UNKNOWN.
sub_products.notes: Receive capability confirmed; Early Pay Day footnote: 'instant payments processed through the RTP® network or FedNow℠ service... are not eligible for Early Pay Day' (they post as ordinary credits). How they are labeled in Account Activity still not published.

sub_products.name: Early Pay Day (ACH direct deposit early availability)
sub_products.description: Up to 2 business days early, timing varies with payor file receipt; alerts optional.

sub_products.name: Set up direct deposit (prefilled form generator)
sub_products.description: Accounts menu 'Set Up Direct Deposit' → 'Prefill your direct deposit form': 3 steps (select up to 3 accounts → allocate deposits across them → verify) → 'Create Form' produces a prefilled PDF to 'provide … to the company or agency that pays you'; 'Or download a blank form'. With one account the allocation step is skipped. No embedded payroll-provider switch (no employer search / credential-based switch).
sub_products.other_flags: payroll_switch_embedded: No; split_across_up_to_n_accounts: 3
sub_products.notes: Mobile path published as 'create Direct Deposit form in app' (S025); web observed.

name: Wells Fargo Vantage® (replacing Commercial Electronic Office® / CEO®)
former_names: Commercial Electronic Office (CEO) portal; CEO Mobile (app renamed Wells Fargo Vantage)
ui_position: Sign-on wellsoffice.ceo.wellsfargo.com; Vantage mobile app (iOS/Android, formerly CEO Mobile); Tasks hub; User Profile > App Settings > Mobile token.
description: Next-generation commercial digital banking platform (microfrontends, APIs, AI/ML, GraphQL) with persona-driven dashboard, Tasks hub, Message Center alerts, dual custody, RSA mobile token, biometrics, Secure Validation (SMS/voice codes) and Token Validation (PIN + RSA SecurID). Published workflows: 'Review and approve payments, Process exceptions, Manage company users, Sign documents, View balances, Paydown loans, View transaction detail, Transfer money, Create wires, Create FX payments'. CEO being phased out with both available during migration (2026). Vantage mobile 2026 cadence (App Store): Tasks hub for ACH Fraud Filter/Positive Pay (Feb 17), domestic wire approvals (Mar 17), all wire approvals (Jul 21), Positive Pay decisions in Fraud Manager + Wires Status Search (Sep 10), approvals for wires/federal tax payments/book transfers/drawdowns + Cash Accounts history (Oct 13), payments tasks on home screen + 3 months card history + iPad (Nov 5). Tokenized deposits (on-chain, 24/7/365 settlement, smart-contract programmability) announced Aug 4 2026 for select corporate/commercial clients (USD→GBP pilot fall 2026; broader 2027 rollout), integrated into existing offering with automatic routing.
